topology_reasoning.device: A compact folded Bragg/corrugated-waveguide structure: a narrow straight center bus passes between two long, periodically corrugated portions of a single folded guide. The guide enters from the upper left, makes a broad right-hand return, crosses a lower corrugated section, then makes a broad left-hand return and exits at the lower right.
topology_reasoning.operation: The periodic lateral corrugations provide distributed Bragg interaction while the nearby straight bus provides the through channel; the long folded route packs interaction length into the 18.24 um by 0.70 um footprint.
function_knobs: right_radius and left_radius: folded-route bend radii

iterations.change_made: Initial primitive reconstruction; comparison showed the outer folded path too tall and the lower corrugated leg vertically offset.
Tried wider cores and inward vertical shifts; this broadened the mismatch, so the next iteration restores the better baseline.
Restored the best baseline after the failed wider-core trial.
Tried larger smoothing radii for the folded path; it marginally reduced fidelity, so the final script restores the baseline geometry.
Final flattened primitives-only GDS retained the best baseline silhouette and enables deterministic layer-area verification.
